text: And after{H310} this it came to pass, that David{H1732} smote{H5221} the Philistines,{H6430} and subdued{H3665} them: and David{H1732} took{H3947} the bridle{H4965} of the mother city out of the hand{H3027} of the Philistines.{H6430}
